newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up on overseas demand, weak ringgit.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up on overseas demand, weak ringgit.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia ended five cents higher at 14.15 ringgit ($5.64) a kg due to a weaker ringgit against the dollar and on good buying from abroad, despite a market holiday in London on Monday, traders said.
They saw an opening bid of 88 tonnes against offer of 65 tonnes. Final volume was 68 tonnes, against 77 tonnes previously with buying mainly from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.

"The market looks steady today. With a weaker ringgit and some good buying from Japan, prices just moved up," a trader said, adding that players are waiting for the re-opening of the London market tonight. The local price premium was unchanged at Monday's $85. --Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5080 ringgit)
